answer.justification: Median first divergence is 0 and edit distance is 0.767, close to the system-prompted range (0.79-0.82) and far from quantized or fine-tuned. Top-1 agreement is 0.867 and sequence agreement 0.312, both in the system-prompted range. The activation profile also matches: layer-1 difference 0.145, onset at layer 8, plateau of 0.473 at layer 16 and 0.493 at layer 32, effective rank 2.75, cosine 0.855. The layer-2 spike of 61.9 fits system-prompted (31.7-64.0) and is far above anything seen for quantized or fine-tuned models (max 6.1). KL of 0.360 and layer-1 L2 of 0.145 are slightly above the documented ranges, but the other features all point the same way. Fine-tuned is ruled out by the median divergence of 0, the large spike and the low effective rank paired with low direction consistency (0.537).
